title: Odyssey-2 Max: Real-time Generative World Simulator
summary: Odyssey-2 Max is a large-scale generative world model that simulates physical reality in real-time using autoregressive diffusion. It enables interactive streaming of 3D environments with high physics accuracy for robotics, gaming, and simulation.
research_notes: Uses an Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer (AR DiT) architecture; holds state-of-the-art scores on VBench 2 for physics accuracy.

evolution.summary: Evolved from video generation to a 'physical intelligence' engine; Odyssey-2 Max scales parameters 3x over Odyssey-2 Pro and utilizes NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. It is currently in private beta for robotics and defense partners.
